title: Fuji United Holdings and Fuji Kosan report unauthorized server access and personal data leak; web ordering suspended
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Fuji United Holdings announced on 24 November that some servers run by it and its subsidiary Fuji Kosan were accessed by a third party and part of the data, including personal information, leaked. Fuji Kosan suspended web ordering as a precaution. The article says the number of records, the data items, and the entry route have not been disclosed.
plain: Fuji United Holdings and Fuji Kosan say outsiders accessed some of their servers and some personal data leaked. Web ordering is suspended. The number affected has not been disclosed.
exec: Web ordering at Fuji Kosan is suspended after a reported data leak; scope not disclosed.
geo_basis: company locations not stated in the page read; country-level marker at Tokyo
